summary: Grocery shopping games, cooking & role play mini games for toddlers age 3 to 6
description:
Welcome to Supermarket Game: Shop, Cook & Play — the ultimate pretend play world for toddlers and preschool kids! This interactive grocery store game is packed with exciting mini games where your child can shop, cook, drive, decorate, and explore a vibrant world of imagination. Designed for toddlers and young kids, this colorful and interactive grocery store simulator is perfect for learning and fun.

Step into a vibrant supermarket world with Mimi and her mom! Shop using your shopping list, play cooking & decorating games, complete tasks, earn rewards, and unlock exciting surprises. With child-friendly controls and smooth animations, this shopping mall kids game is one of the best supermarket shopping games for kids.

🛍️ What’s Inside the Supermarket?
Explore a full virtual supermarket mall divided into fun interactive sections:
🥐 Bakery & Confectionery – Pick bread, cookies, and more!
🍭 Candy Store & Toys – Drag and collect colorful candies and toys.
🧁 Food Court – Feed characters and unlock mini-games.
💐 Flower Shop – Decorate with animated flowers.
❄️ Cold Store – Cool items, ice-cream, and surprises!

 Let your little one explore the joy of shopping in a realistic grocery store designed for toddlers aged 4–6. From choosing their shopping cart to checking out at the cash counter, kids will enjoy a full role play shopping experience.

Why This is the Best Supermarket Game for Kids? 
- Supermarket shopping for kids: Grab your grocery list, pick your cart, scan items, and check out at the cashier. 
- Mini cooking games for toddlers: Cut, mix, bake, and decorate simple recipes in a fun, interactive kitchen. 
- Car driving game: Pretend you're driving through a supermarket parking lot, delivering food or picking up groceries! 
- House decorating mini game: Choose furniture, paint colors, and room decor to build your dream home. 
- Cash counter role play: Learn basic money skills by scanning products, giving change, and printing receipts. 
- Pretend play world: A safe space where kids use creativity, logic, and storytelling to explore freely.

🌟 Key Features
* Perfect for toddlers, preschoolers, and kindergarteners
* Combines pretend play with role play and educational fun
* Safe, ad-free, and child-friendly design
* Voice-guided controls ideal for independent play
* No internet needed – play offline anywhere

🎯 Who’s it for?
Toddlers (age 3–6), preschoolers, and young kids who love:

- Grocery shopping role play
- Cooking games for kids
- Home makeover and decorating
- Driving and delivery games
- Cash register and money counting
- Pizza maker & cake maker games

This app ranks among the top kids’ games, joining the likes of Kids Supermarket Shopping, My Town Store Game, and Grocery Superstore Simulator.

🧠 Educational Benefits Your child will build early life skills in counting, sorting, logic, and sequencing while immersed in imaginative role play. Whether it’s learning about food categories in the grocery store or practicing decision-making in mini games, this pretend world is designed to support playful learning.
